scope.model_families: all live OpenRouter models; common-index measured configurations only are actionable
scope.coverage: Complete catalog/release screening; exact configuration verification for candidate winners. Unmatched models remain pending, not assigned invented scores.
scope.eligibility: Released and publicly routable with exact comparable AA score/cost, native reasoning control and standard provider revision verified.
scope.frontier_completeness: verified_routing_subset; not a global optimum over every measured AA configuration

benchmark.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
benchmark.score_representation: underlying_public_source_numbers; display rounding only; numerical precision is not statistical certainty
benchmark.cost_basis: AA weighted task costs calculated from observed benchmark token use and published provider token prices, not an OpenRouter invoice estimate.
benchmark.cost_source_updated_at_note: AA retrieval time is recorded; AA does not publish a per-row update timestamp.
benchmark.evaluation_run_date_note: 2026-10-30 is the source verification date; exact AA evaluation completion dates remain unpublished.
benchmark.methodology_transition_note: All compared current records reacquired. Scores and weighted task costs are not directly comparable across index versions; specialized profiles retain their own separately verified evaluation versions.

selection_policy.objective: Minimum observed measured benchmark task cost for a minimum score; maximum observed score at or below a benchmark task cost budget.
selection_policy.use_case_limits: A broad composite; benchmark points are not equal units of practical utility. Workload, context, tool support, review cost and reliability can change the best choice.
selection_policy.free_routes: Verified first-party free configuration exposed separately, requires allow_limited_free:true. Default frontier excludes limited free routes. Neither token discounts nor free aliases overwrite measured AA costs.
selection_policy.price_basis: Both queries use AA benchmark-task cost; these are not dollar caps on a production prompt.

floor.confidence: workload_conditional_frontier_heuristic; intervals not equal practical utility
floor.rationale: Workload-conditional floor: next step adds 5.285996 points for $0.090136 (+126.35%), $0.017052/point, 6.39x the preceding marginal rate. Compare actual success rate, latency and review effort before paying above it.
floor.recommendation_method: First >=3x adjacent marginal cost/point increase accompanied by >=50% higher task cost; descriptive heuristic, not a universal optimum.
